metrics_source: User-supplied Tactile-JEPA manuscript, uncommented main and ablation tables. No inference from earlier repository report snapshots.

sampling.paired_targets: two targets per part; mixed = one local and one random per part

limitations: Graphs are repository visualizations and have not been matched to every final checkpoint.
No recorded signal, video, reconstruction or model prediction is bundled.
Socks pose metric unit requires review: manuscript says rad but scale needs confirmation.
DECO main table and ablation report different runs/values; retained separately.
Spread is reproduced as reported, not relabelled as a confidence interval.

display_layouts.paper_method: The manuscript uses fixed sensor adjacency for mask sampling, not display coordinates.

xela.spatial: Saved 3D sensor coordinates, one fixed hand configuration.
xela.flat: Orthographic projection of the saved coordinates; visualization only.

socks.flat: Source planar physical sensor map; right foot mirrored for separated display.
socks.spatial: Illustrative curved sole with an arch, cupped rim and toe bend; not measured anatomy.

deco.flat: Canonical planar layout used by the repository graph builder. Edge weights remain topological unit distances.
deco.spatial: Illustrative palm cup and bent fingers; not calibrated kinematics or a measured hand pose.

display_layouts.invariants: Both layouts preserve node IDs, graph edges, target/context membership and reported results.
